svg.title: Driver range, waveform crest and acquisition settling constrain different choices
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: Driver range, waveform crest and acquisition settling constrain different choices
Complete waveform at converter pins; nominal 2 V differential span
Supplied single-pole full-span step model, 3 ns effective tracking window
24 dB passes tone peaks but fails the supplied broadband crest bound; 22 dB passes both.
At 16 bits the model needs τ ≤0.254593 ns; actual kickback / slew / recovery need evidence.
Common mode, pin limits, loading and reference isolation remain separate interfaces.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
